LanguageData.MUGBTipSwarmPheromone: Goblins are small and weak, but combat pheromones make a gathered mob more dangerous.
LanguageData.MUGBTipHobgoblin: Hobgoblins are rare elite troops. Give them priority for better equipment and leadership roles.
LanguageData.MUGBTipSquadLeader: Goblin squad leaders sustain their squad's morale. Eliminating one early can make the squad rout quickly.
LanguageData.MUGBTipButchery: Goblins can butcher humanlike corpses for human bones and useful organs.
LanguageData.MUGBTipFleshCraving: Neglected flesh cravings reduce a goblin's mood, consciousness, and movement.
LanguageData.MUGBTipCooking: Goblin cooking makes efficient use of guts and body parts.
LanguageData.MUGBTipFarming: Goblins tolerate toxic environments but are poor farmers. Plan food production early.
LanguageData.MUGBTipBeacon: A goblin beacon burns a goblin corpse to attract the attention of other goblins.
LanguageData.MUGBTipBeaconQuality: The quality of a beacon ritual affects the size and nature of the goblins that answer it.
LanguageData.MUGBTipBeaconRisk: A goblin beacon may attract hostile attention as well as friendly visitors.
LanguageData.MUGBTipSlaveMarriage: Slave marriage is a goblin group ritual that binds the master side and slave side together.
LanguageData.MUGBTipPheromoneAdaptation: By default, goblin slave marriage requires pheromone adaptation. This requirement can be changed in the mod settings.
LanguageData.MUGBTipConcubinage: Slave marriage creates a concubine relationship separate from formal marriage.
LanguageData.MUGBTipCentralTunnel: A central tunnel raid opens a cluster of tunnels within one attack area.
LanguageData.MUGBTipTunnelReinforcements: Surviving tunnels release reinforcements over time. Destroy them before the next wave.
LanguageData.MUGBTipLargeTunnel: Large tunnels release more troops and continue reinforcing longer than ordinary tunnels.
LanguageData.MUGBTipMortarSiege: Goblin mortar raids build field fortifications and prepare a bombardment. Cutting off the supply tunnels makes a long siege easier.
LanguageData.MUGBTipBoomstickSappers: Boomstick sappers blast through walls with explosives. Narrow passages are especially dangerous.
LanguageData.MUGBTipBaseTunnel: Defensive tunnels may activate as the defenders of a goblin base are depleted.
LanguageData.MUGBTipCaravanAmbush: Goblin ambushes can target caravans on the world map. Take extra care near hostile goblin settlements.
LanguageData.MUGBTipSpecialWeapons: Special weapons can be obtained as rare squad-leader loot, quest rewards, and ideology relics.
LanguageData.MUGBTipSculptures: Goblin sculptures improve Children of Blinia ideology rituals.
LanguageData.MUGBTipGrowth: Pure goblins mature rapidly. A newborn goblin soon becomes useful manpower.
LanguageData.MUGBTipThinAndHob: Thin goblins suit cheap labor and massed troops, while hobgoblins excel in elite roles.
